items.requirement: Merged: srv-05, USER175-06, cmgap-D01, CMGAP-D01, cmcont-10, CMCONT-02, D9-04, CMLM-03, cmpolreq-01, and the password part of d9-02b. Depends on laravel USER175-11, which provides the seeding switch in config. CodeMart passwords follow config/service_contract.json#codemart_admin_password. (1) Add the command class codemart:admin-password --file <path> in app/Apps/CodeMartV1/CodeMartV1Commands/. It reads the file and sets the hashed password on every account the CodeMart seeder creates (admin and demo users). It is idempotent, with CLI text through lang keys. laravel registers it (USER175-07). (2) CodeMartV1DemoSeeder no longer has DEMO_PASSWORD (:55, :765, :835-836). It reads the contract secret file under the laravel_db dir (PathMapper/RuntimeConfigurationStore). When the file is missing, it generates one with the contract length and alphabet, reusing the existing InstallationAccessCode random helper, writes it 0600 and prints it. It never rehashes an existing account's password; the command is the only rotator. (3) CodeMartV1Initializer.php:537-562 reads config('services.codemart_seed_demo') (LaravelConfig, default true per D17), and its comment is corrected.
items.verify: php -l passes. A grep for 'Codemart#2026' finds nothing. Inside a rolled-back PG transaction, with the secret path pointed at a scratchpad file by reflection or config override: the seeder creates the accounts and Hash::check(filePassword) is true for each. A second seed leaves the hashes unchanged. The command with a new file rotates every hash; with the same file it changes nothing. Roll back and delete the scratch file.
